# SAMPLE RUNS — GERMAN (UCI Statlog German credit) — 5-feature model

**Committee-facing acceptance pack (reviewed BEFORE the Go/No-Go decision).** Generated by `ml_models/score_acceptance_cases.py` from `german.json` — reproducible, not one-off.

**Model:** AEGIS-approved WOE-logistic (5 features) · **Portfolio default rate:** 30.0% · PD floored at 0.03% (Basel CRE32.3).

> **Scope.** This pack reports only methodology/regulation-grounded outputs: calibrated PD, rating grade (risk tier, on the institution's internal master scale), exact WOE reason codes, and the governed completeness decision. The **accept / refer / decline lending decision is set by the institution applying its own risk-appetite PD threshold** — it is exogenous to this methodology and is **not** derived or priced here.

**Case composition (fixed standard):** 4 real applicants (drawn from the dataset, observed outcome shown — defaulted / repaid) + 2 synthetic composites (constructed from observed feature-value extremes; outcome shown is the construction intent, "(by design)", not an observed outcome — a PD-floor check and a stress check). Real cases span the risk range and include both outcomes.

## Per-candidate showcase (what a new applicant report looks like)

### DE-R1 (low-risk, good)

**Type:** real · **Outcome:** repaid

**Inputs:** checking_status=no checking account, credit_history=critical account / other credits elsewhere, months_duration=6.0, savings_status=100 ≤ ... < 500 DM, purpose=radio/television

**Governed decision:** SCORE · raw PD 1.97% → **calibrated PD 0.03%** (0.00× portfolio) · grade **AAA** (Exceptional)

| Feature | Value | WOE | Contribution | Effect |
|---|---|--:|--:|---|
| months_duration | 6.0 | +1.246 | -1.240 | lowers risk |
| checking_status | no checking account | +1.176 | -0.959 | lowers risk |
| credit_history | critical account / other credits elsewhere | +0.734 | -0.564 | lowers risk |
| purpose | radio/television | +0.410 | -0.406 | lowers risk |
| savings_status | 100 ≤ ... < 500 DM | -0.140 | +0.101 | raises risk |

**Principal (adverse-action) reasons:** savings_status
